about_the_game:
Eastwynne is an isometric RPG with visual novel elements inspired by both the classics and new entries of the genre. It takes place in a modern fantasy setting, featuring a heavy narrative, branching storylines, and character progression.

On an Earth where humans and mages coexist, Eastwynne is the most influential city in the Commonwealth of Magic. It's a city filled to the brim with high society life, the best of the best businesses, and real estate. Maybe not the best people, but you got everything else.

Play as Ester or Sye as they navigate college and life.

Your actions will affect the course of the story, what you learn, what you can accomplish, and who chooses to stand beside you.

If the pressure of decision-making is getting to you, there are difficulty options that will give you hints about major choices and decrease the difficulty of dice rolls and battles. Or you can live life on the edge and have no consequence warnings at all...

Magic flows everywhere. Develop skills and learn new spells, leading towards specific specializations that can aid you both in exploration and beyond. Learn what works and doesn't, what you can counter, and what you're weak against. Magic doesn't always equate to violence, but sometimes it does​.

It's 2021, and the start of a new college year. How it'll go is dependent on you.

  • CHOICES & BRANCHING NARRATIVES 🍂 Influence the paths that should be taken and change the narrative. Your choices can heavily alter a playthrough. This expands beyond just choosing different dialogue; even doing things in a different order or making a discovery has an impact.

  • EXPLORATION AND COMBAT ✨ There's a lot to uncover as you explore the world. The spells and skills learned can help you navigate both in and out of combat.

  • CLASSIC RPG ELEMENTS 🎲 Grow through skill progression, complete quests, and see if luck is on your side with dice rolls and checks.

  • DEEP RELATIONSHIPS, PARTY-BASED 💖 You can choose to go it alone or with companions. There are many characters you can meet, befriend, romance, or make enemies of.

  • MANAGE YOUR TIME WISELY ⏱️ Will you prioritize studying and assignments to boost your stats, or relax? Stay in, or maybe explore the city and hang out with your friends?

  • Voiced in English, featuring a super amazing cast & captivating original soundtrack 🎼

content_descriptors.notes: Content Warnings: Social issues/sensitive topics, mild to strong violence, mild to strong language, and other mature themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows 8.1
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K (4th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPUs with at least 4GB of VRAM: GTX 1050 Ti, GTX 980 or Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 (10th Gen) or Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPUs with at least 6GB of VRAM or higher: RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 5600
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A narrative-focused CRPG set in the grandiose city of Eastwynne, where magic is commonplace. It's 2021, and the start of a new college year. Follow the stories of a group of magical university students; how will your choices alter their lives?
